import json

# Parse the order data from excel_data to build a structured summary request
lines = excel_data.strip().split('\n')
# Extract order rows (skip header line and the OBSERVATION prefix)
orders = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('(') and not line.startswith('(1,'):
        # Parse each cell
        parts = line.split('\t')
        row_data = {}
        for part in parts:
            part = part.strip()
            if not part:
                continue
            # Format: (row, col): value
            if '): ' in part:
                key_val = part.split('): ', 1)
                coords = key_val[0].strip('(')
                val = key_val[1] if len(key_val) > 1 else ''
                row_num, col_num = coords.split(', ')
                row_data[int(col_num)] = val
        if row_data:
            orders.append(row_data)

# Build a clean table for the subagent
# Column mapping: 1=Order ID, 2=Customer, 3=Date, 4=Status, 5=Items, 6=Total Paid
table_lines = ["Order ID | Customer | Date | Status | Items | Total Paid"]
table_lines.append("---|---|---|---|---|---")
for o in orders:
    table_lines.append(f"{o.get(1,'')} | {o.get(2,'')} | {o.get(3,'')} | {o.get(4,'')} | {o.get(5,'')} | ${o.get(6,'')}")

order_table = '\n'.join(table_lines)

    "average order value, top 5 customers by number of orders, most frequently ordered products, date range, "
    "and any notable trends or patterns. Return ONLY the summary text, no code, no markdown fences. "
    "Here is the order data:\n\n" + order_table
)

print(summary_result)

print("Preview:", summary_result.strip()[:400])
